name: Luminette® Privacy Sheers
description: Luminette® Privacy Sheers combine the beauty of sheer draperies with the light control and privacy of a blind, perfect for wide windows and sliding glass doors.

benefits.text:
Superior Light Control 
Create the preferred amount of light in a room with rotating fabric vanes that 
offer 180 degrees of control. 
Innovative Vertical Design  
Luminette® sheers fuse the functionality of vertical blinds with the drama of 
drapery, providing stunning dimension and privacy that’s ideal for large panes 
of glass and sliding glass doors.
UV Protection with View-Through 
Luminette sheers offer unobstructed outdoor views and protect interior 
furnishings from intense sunlight, so they maintain their appearance.
The Whole House Solution™ 
Luminette fabrics coordinate with horizontal Silhouette® Window Shadings, 
Pirouette® Window Shadings and Vignette® Modern Roman Shades, making it easy 
to create a unified look throughout the home. 
Beautiful Light Diffusion 
Luminette sheers diffuse light to create a soft glow, keeping rooms looking and 
feeling comfortable, welcoming and serene.
Expansive Fabric Collection   
With a large selection of fabrics and colors, Luminette sheers easily complement 
every interior design style.
Benefits of Luminette® 
sheers include 
stunning light diffusion 
and luxurious fabrics 
that enhance the 
beauty of your home.

Light-Filtering Vanes (Open)
When open, light-filtering fabric vanes let in natural sunlight and maximize 
view-through.
Room-Darkening Vanes (Open)
When open, room-darkening fabric vanes let in natural sunlight and maximize 
view-through.
Fabric Stria™    Color Alabaster
Operating System PowerView® Automation
Light-Filtering Vanes (Closed)
When closed, light-filtering fabric vanes offer soft light diffusion.
Room-Darkening Vanes (Closed)
When closed, room-darkening fabric vanes block most light and offer 
enhanced privacy.

A Day With PowerView®  
10:30 PM Bedtime
Sheers close automatically for privacy and a perfect night’s sleep.
7:00 AM Morning
Schedule sheers to operate at your preferred wake-up time.
5 Minutes Before Sunset
Based on your local sunset time, sheers open to reveal your best view.
2:00 PM Afternoon
Sheers adjust to protect furnishings from harsh midday sunlight.

Operating System PowerView® Automation

Headrail Color
Luminette® headrails are concealed by fabric, available in six colors.
Side Stack
Sheers open from the left or right side of the door or window and stack on one side.
Split Stack 
Sheers open from the center of the door or window and stack on both sides.
Accents by the Yard™
Every Luminette fabric is offered as cut yardage, so you can create coordinating 
home accents like pillows and duvets.
